name: lz-camera-sync
description: Back up, align and restore the settings of several Sony cameras (FX3 first) — desktop and mobile.

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js --linux --publish never
scripts.fake-camera: rolldown scripts/fake-camera.ts --platform node --format esm --external ssh2 --file dist-fake/fake-camera.mjs --log-level warn && node dist-fake/fake-camera.mjs
scripts.probe: rolldown scripts/probe-camera.ts --platform node --format esm --external ssh2 --file dist-fake/probe-camera.mjs --log-level warn && node dist-fake/probe-camera.mjs
scripts.write-test: rolldown scripts/write-test-camera.ts --platform node --format esm --external ssh2 --file dist-fake/write-test-camera.mjs --log-level warn && node dist-fake/write-test-camera.mjs
